desc: Built on their experience in the field, the RazorGuide Pak combines the necessary tools for hunters in a compact waxed canvas roll pack. Featuring two RazorSafe replaceable blade knives and a saw, the RazorGuide Pak is ready to meet the demands of even the most experienced guides. The RazorBone comes equipped with 3.5" drop-point blades, gutting blade and 5.0" boning/fillet blades to bring your harvest from the field to the table with a single knife.
